lines.en: We have an old musical instrument.
lines.zh: 我们有一件古老的乐器。

lines.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
Our clavichord is kept in the living room.
lines.zh: 我们的古钢琴被放在客厅里。

lines.en: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
lines.zh: 它属于我们家已经很长时间了。

lines.en: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
lines.zh: 这件乐器是我祖父多年前买的。

lines.en: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
lines.zh: 最近它被一位访客损坏了。

lines.en: She tried to play jazz on it!
lines.zh: 她试图用它演奏爵士乐！

lines.en: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
lines.zh: 她敲击琴键太用力，结果两根琴弦断了。

lines.en: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
lines.zh: 现在我们不被允许碰它。

lines.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
lines.zh: 它正在由我父亲的一位朋友修理。
